author: Houssem0x1
notes: All timestamps must be in UTC and should be in the following format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
You have to answer all the questions with the required format to get the flag at the end.

questions.question: What was the last text copied by the user?
When did the victim visit the malicious website?
What is the the Mitre ATT&CK sub-technique ID relevant to the way the Threat actor gained execution on the victim's machine?
What is the filename of the legitimate software that the malware was disguised as?
What is the SHA-1 hash of the malware?
Which Mitre ATT&CK stealth technique best describes the action of the identified in the previous question?
What is the username and the NT hash of the new admin account that the TA created as for their 1st persistence technique?
What is the the Mitre ATT&CK sub-technique ID relevant to the 2nd Persistence mechanism achieved by the TA?
MS Windows defender flagged the malicious file/object responsible for the 2nd persistence mechanism identified in the previous question. What is its threat tracking size in bytes?
the TA downloaded a RMM software on the system for further activities, what is the tool name and when it was downloaded?
How many bytes of data did the malware binary send to the C2 server in total?
What is the total runtime duration of the malware in Ms (Milliseconds)?
The TA dropped a malicious script for data exfiltration, what is the script filename and what is the the IP address the data was being exfiltrated to?
questions.hint: Not Necessarly the same as execution phase IP address

questions.question: What is the execution/launch timestamp of the exfiltration script identified in the previous question?
Recovery procedure is documented in a RTF document, what is the last name of document author and what he advises as first recovery step?
As for anti-forensics, When did the TA clear the event logs?
Besides data exfiltration, the TA deployed a ransomware at the end, what is the new extension of the encrypted files?
Late after the attack, the victim received a message from his work colleague alerting him that his machine is being compromised. What is the name of this colleague?
What is the employee's role on the company, and what is his badge number?
Based on the IOCs, which framework serves as the C2 on this incident?
